sql: WITH t AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, strategy, created_at, closed_at, quantity, pnl FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('mmsell10','Basemmsell10') AND upper(split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)) LIKE '%MENTION%' AND quantity > 0 ORDER BY market_ticker, created_at) SELECT strategy, count(*) AS first_entries, count(*) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND closed_at >= '2026-10-15') AS settled_since_1015, count(*) FILTER (WHERE closed_at IS NULL) AS open FROM t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
